description: Native Get New Messages via Thunderbird mail internals (Experiment). Retest after major Thunderbird upgrades.

functions.name: fetchCurrentAccount
functions.description: Trigger Get New Messages for the account implied by the active mail 3-pane selection (current account).

functions.name: fetchAccount
functions.description: Trigger Get New Messages for the given mail account id (WebExtension accounts id / key).

functions.name: fetchAllAccounts
functions.description: Trigger Get New Messages for every mail account that has an Inbox.
